title: The Constituion of Jamaica- Proclamation 21_2022
text:
DEC. 28, 2022] PROCLAMATIONS, RULES AND REGULATIONS 2769
THE
JAMAICA GAZETTE
SUPPLEMENT
PROCLAMATIONS, RULES AND REGULATIONS
2769
Vol. CXLV WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 28, 2022 No. 319
Proclamation No. 21/2022
JAMAICA
THE CONSTITUTION OF JAMAICA
A P R O C L A M A T I O N
By His Excellency, the Most Honourable Sir
PATRICK LINTON ALLEN, Member of the Order
of the Nation, Knight Grand Cross of the Most
L.S. Distinguished Order of Saint Michael and Saint
George, Commander of the Order of Distinction,
Knight of Grace of the Most Venerable Order
PATRICK L. ALLEN, of the Hospital of Saint John of Jerusalem,
Governor-General. Governor-General of Jamaica.

2770 PROCLAMATIONS, RULES AND REGULATIONS [DEC. 28, 2022
WHEREAS by virtue of section 20(1) of the Constitution of Jamaica, the Governor-General
may make a Proclamation declaring that a state of public emergency exists:
AND WHEREAS section 20(2) of the Constitution of Jamaica provides that a Proclamation made
under section 20 shall not be effective for the purposes of subsection (1) unless it is declared
that the Governor-General is satisfied, inter alia that action has been taken or is immediately
threatened by any person or body of persons of such a nature and on so extensive a scale as to
be likely to endanger the public safety or to deprive the community, or any substantial portion
of the community, of supplies or services essential to life:
AND WHEREAS section 20(3) of the Constitution of Jamaica specifies that a Proclamation made
by the Governor-General for the purposes of and in accordance with that section shall, unless
previously revoked, remain in force for fourteen days or for such longer period, not exceeding
three months, as both Houses of Parliament may determine by a resolution supported by a two-
thirds majority of all the members of each House:
AND WHEREAS I am satisfied that action has been taken or is immediately threatened by persons
or bodies of persons of such a nature and on so extensive a scale as to be likely to endanger the
public safety of the community specified in the Schedule:
AND WHEREAS I am satisfied that a state of public emergency exists in the communities specified
in the Schedule as a result of the aforementioned circumstances:
NOW, THEREFORE, I, PATRICK LINTON ALLEN, Member of the Order of the Nation, Knight
Grand Cross of the Most Distinguished Order of Saint Michael and Saint George, Commander of
the Order of Distinction, Knight of Grace of the Most Venerable Order of the Hospital of Saint
John of Jerusalem, Governor-General of Jamaica, in exercise of the power conferred upon me by
section 20 of the Constitution of Jamaica, and of every other power hereunto enabling, DO
HEREBY DECLARE that—
(a) a state of public emergency exists in the communities specified in the Schedule; and
(b) this Proclamation shall, unless previously revoked, remain in force for fourteen days
or for such longer period, not exceeding three months, as both Houses of Parliament
may determine by a resolution supported by a two-thirds majority of all the members
of each House.

DEC. 28, 2022] PROCLAMATIONS, RULES AND REGULATIONS 2771
SCHEDULE
Communities in which a State of Public Emergency Exists
The area of land comprising the entire parishes of St. James, Westmoreland and
Hanover within the established parish borders, that is to say—
East: The eastern boundary starts at the easternmost point of St. James, at
the coastal intersection of the parish boundaries of St. James and
Trelawny. The eastern boundary then extends in a south-westerly
direction along the shared parish borders of St. James and Trelawny,
St. Elizabeth and also Westmoreland to the southern coast.
South: The southern boundary then extends in a westerly direction along
the entire coast of Westmoreland to the westernmost point of the
Island.
West: The western boundary then extends in a northerly direction along the
shared coastline of Westmoreland and then Hanover, to the
westernmost point of Hanover.
North: The northern boundary continues along the coast of Hanover and
St. James and back to the easternmost point of the shared coastal
boundary of St. James and Trelawny.
Given under my hand and the Broad Seal of Jamaica at King’s House, this 28th day of
December in the Year of Our Lord Two Thousand and Twenty-two and the First Year of the
Reign of His Majesty King Charles III.
GOD SAVE THE KING
